question: When should guru worship be done and what kind of guru is to be honored?
premises: Guru worship is to be done on the next day and always, according to the Siddhayogishvari teaching.
The guru must possess the previously stated marks.
The guru must be a seer who knows the true principle of the Trika.
inference: The concluding worship is directed to a properly qualified guru grounded in Trika realization.
uncertainties: The 'previously stated marks' refer back to qualifications not listed in this verse.
plain_english: According to the teaching of the Siddhayogishvari, it should always be done on the next day. The guru to be honored is one endowed with the previously stated marks, a seer who knows the true principle of the Trika.
